name: Orient Beverages Limited
about: Orient Beverages Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the beverages business in India. The company manufactures, markets, and trades in packaged drinking water under the BISLERI brand; and soft drinks under the GOLD SPOT, LIMCA, THUMPS UP, CITRA, and BISLERI CLUB SODA brands. It also deals in the real estate activities. The company was formerly known as Orient Properties Private Limited and changed its name to Orient Beverages Limited in 1971. Orient Beverages Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Kolkata, India.
